clinical_trials.title: Metformin Versus Insulin in Gestational Diabetes. A Randomized Controlled Single Center Trial.
clinical_trials.brief_summary: Gestational diabetes is traditionally treated with insulin. The investigators aim is to compare insulin and metformin in the treatment of gestational diabetes. The investigators hypothesis is that there is no difference between insulin and metformin treated mothers in the main outcome criteria (birth weight, neonatal complications).

clinical_trials.brief_summary: Diabetic Retinopathy is the leading cause of blindness in the world. This study examines the effect of pulsatile insulin on patients with varying stages of diabetic retinal disease.

literature.title: Efficacy and safety comparison of rapid-acting insulin aspart and regular human insulin in the treatment of type 1 and type 2 diabetes mellitus: a systematic review.
literature.abstract: Insulin aspart (IAsp) is one of the three rapid-acting insulin analogues (RAAs) registered for the treatment of diabetes. However, there is an ongoing debate concerning the efficacy and safety of RAAs. For this reason, a systematic review-based study was performed to compare clinical outcomes of treatment with IAsp and regular human insulin (RHI) as well as biphasic insulin aspart and premixed human insulin in type 1 and type 2 diabetes (T1DM, T2DM) patients.

Insulin therapy represents a cornerstone in the treatment of diabetes and has been used widely for achieving glycemic goals. Nevertheless, a large portion of the population with diabetes does not meet the internationally agreed glycemic targets. Degludec insulin can be formulated together with Aspart insulin in a 70/30 fixed ratio product. We review the potential use of Degludec-Aspart in type 1 diabetes. literature.title: Biphasic insulin aspart 30 for the treatment of type 1 diabetes mellitus.
literature.abstract: Type 1 diabetes mellitus is associated with acute and long-term complications, to which pre- and postprandial hyperglycemia are independent contributors. The objective of this review was to evaluate evidence-based information using biphasic insulin aspart 30 in the treatment of type 1 diabetes mellitus.

Several studies have been conducted evaluating the pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of faster insulin aspart, compared with insulin aspart. Most patients with T1DM should follow a regimen of multiple daily injections of basal/bolus insulin, but those not meeting individual glycemic targets or those with frequent or severe hypoglycemia or pronounced dawn phenomenon should consider continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion. literature.abstract: Pramlintide improves postprandial glucose but requires additional injections. We investigated the pharmacokinetics/pharmacodynamics, efficacy and safety of ADO09, pramlintide/insulin A21G co-formulation, in type 1 diabetes (T1D).

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Insulin aspart 為速效胰島素類似物，以 B28 Pro→Asp 胺基酸替換減少自聚合傾向，皮下注射後 10-20 分鐘起效，60 分鐘達峰，模擬生理性餐後胰島素分泌。T1DM 患者胰島 β 細胞完全破壞，胰島素補充為必要治療，Insulin aspart 可用於 CSII（胰島素幫浦）及 MDI（多次注射）方案，直接補充缺失的內源性胰島素功能。

TxGNN 高分可能源自知識圖譜中「自體免疫疾病」節點的間接連結：T1DM（autoimmune）與 autoimmune oophoritis 均為自體免疫病，共享 HLA-DR 易感性，且可共同發生於 APS-1/APS-2（多腺體自體免疫症候群）。然而，Insulin aspart 的作用機轉（替代胰島素功能）與卵巢自體免疫發炎（靶向卵巢組織的自體抗體）無直接關聯，模型可能混淆了「共病關聯」與「治療關聯」。
Opsismodysplasia 為 INPPL1 基因（編碼 SHIP2，磷酸肌醇 5-磷酸酶）突變所致的罕見骨骼發育不良。SHIP2 參與 PI3K/AKT 下游胰島素訊號傳遞，理論上 Insulin 可經 IGF-1R 影響骨骼生長板軟骨細胞，但此為極度推測性機轉。KG 模型可能透過「Insulin → IRS-1 → PI3K → SHIP2」路徑產生高分，屬方法論假陽性。

Thiamine-responsive megaloblastic anemia（TRMA，SLC19A2 突變）三聯症包含糖尿病、巨幼紅血球貧血與感音性耳聾。TRMA 相關糖尿病機轉為 thiamine 轉運缺陷導致胰島 β 細胞氧化壓力，早期胰島素治療為 TRMA 糖尿病的臨床實踐。TxGNN 高分可能來自 TRMA 中的糖尿病表現型與 T1DM 節點重疊。Insulin aspart 在 TRMA 中的應用屬於症狀性胰島素替代，非疾病修飾治療，且 thiamine 補充為優先介入。

literature.title: Insulin therapy in neonatal diabetes mellitus: a review of the literature.
literature.abstract: Neonatal diabetes mellitus (NDM) is a rare disorder, and guidance is limited regarding its optimal management. We reviewed insulin usage in NDM, with a focus on continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII).

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Permanent neonatal diabetes mellitus（PNDM）最常由 KCNJ11 或 ABCC8 突變導致 ATP 敏感性鉀通道功能增益，β 細胞無法回應葡萄糖刺激分泌胰島素。雖然 KCNJ11/ABCC8 PNDM 的一線治療已轉向高劑量磺醯脲素（glibenclamide），但 KATP 無反應者（如 INS 基因突變 PNDM）仍需胰島素替代。Insulin aspart 作為速效類似物理論上可模擬生理性餐後胰島素，但新生兒的劑量準確性、血糖波動管理和 CSII 裝置適用性是主要挑戰。

Focal stiff limb syndrome 為 stiff person spectrum disorders 的局灶性表現，與 GAD65（glutamic acid decarboxylase）自體抗體高度相關。同一自體抗體（anti-GAD65）在 T1DM 患者中亦常見（>70%），這可能是 KG 建立兩病之間連結的原因。然而，Insulin aspart 針對胰島素受體訊號，無抑制 GAD65 自體抗體、調節 GABA 能系統或緩解痙攣的機轉，KG 連結屬共享自體抗原之間接關聯而非治療關聯。

Classic stiff person syndrome（SPS）核心機轉為 anti-GAD65 抗體介導的脊髓及腦幹 GABA 能抑制迴路損傷，導致持續性軀幹與近端肌肉僵硬。T1DM 與 SPS 共享 GAD65 自體免疫背景（HLA-DR3/DR4），約 5% T1DM 患者併發 SPS。TxGNN 評分來自 KG 中的共病節點路徑，但 Insulin aspart 無法修飾 GABA 能神經元功能或抑制 anti-GAD65 自體免疫，治療相關性不成立。

literature.title: Insulin autoimmune syndrome: Three case reports.
literature.abstract: Insulin autoimmune syndrome (IAS) is a rare endocrine disease characterized by repeated fasting hypoglycemia or episodes of hypoglycemia late after meals, elevated serum insulin, and positivity for insulin autoantibody (IAA) or insulin receptor antibody (IRA). We summarize the clinical manifestations and treatment experiences of 3 patients with IAS.

literature.title: Insulin therapy in type 2 diabetes.
literature.journal: Journal of the American Pharmaceutical Association (Washington, D.C. : 1996)
literature.abstract: To review the increasingly common use of insulin therapy in patients with type 2 diabetes and the practical aspects of initiating insulin therapy in these patients.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Pancreatic agenesis（PTF1A、GATA6、PDX1 等基因突變）導致胰臟完全或部分缺失，患者既無內源性胰島素分泌，亦缺乏外分泌胰酶。胰島素替代為必要治療（類同 T1DM 全胰切除後管理）。Insulin aspart 理論上可作為速效胰島素替代，但文獻來源（PMID 30572448 為胰島素自體免疫症候群案例報告；PMID 12150359 為 T2DM 胰島素療法通論）與胰臟發育不全無直接關聯，證據品質有限。
⚠️ 反向因果警示：Insulin aspart（及其他胰島素製劑）重複注射於同一部位本身即為 drug-induced localized lipodystrophy 的已知病因（注射部位脂肪增生或脂肪萎縮）。TxGNN KG 路徑中「胰島素 → 注射部位副作用 → 脂肪代謝異常」的連結可能被模型錯誤詮釋為治療關係，而非致病關係。Insulin aspart 不治療此症，而可能加劇之。

Centrifugal lipodystrophy（AKA lipodystrophia centrifugalis abdominalis infantilis）為罕見兒科脂肪萎縮症，病因不明，可能與皮膚炎症或免疫異常有關。與 Insulin aspart 無已知機轉關聯。KG 評分可能源自「lipodystrophy 節點」與「insulin-associated lipodystrophy」的共享類別連結，屬非特異性圖譜雜訊。
